name: montre
description: Application d'entrainement sportif : suivi social facon Strava + coaching adaptatif facon Decathlon Coach, connectee a la montre GPS Decathlon Fit 100 S.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @montre/core && npm run build -w @montre/server && npm run build -w @montre/web
scripts.start: npm run build -w @montre/core && npm run build -w @montre/web && npm run start -w @montre/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @montre/core && npm run typecheck -w @montre/server && npm run typecheck -w @montre/web
